# NET0ZE (Neetoze)

> NET0ZE (commonly searched as Neetoze or NET0ZE) is an open, local-first cybersecurity investigation and network monitoring desktop platform designed for security researchers, incident responders, SOC analysts, and network administrators.

## Primary Canonical Links
- Official Website: https://neetoze.surge.sh/ (Mirror: https://netoze.surge.sh/)
- GitHub Repository & Releases: https://github.com/1viz3r0/netoze
- Current Stable Version: 2.0.0
- Supported Operating Systems: Linux (x86_64 Debian/Ubuntu .deb, AppImage), Windows (x64 NSIS installer).

## Key Architecture & Distinctive Features
- **Local-First & Zero Telemetry**: All packet captures, host processes, network flows, and incident briefs are processed exclusively on the local machine. No metrics, telemetry, or private data are transmitted to external servers.
- **Unified Evidence Model**: Bridges low-level packet capture (PCAP) with high-level host process telemetry, socket state, and DNS/TLS correlation into clear, exportable findings.
- **Fail-Closed Permission Boundaries**: Strictly enforces privilege boundaries. Requires libpcap/Linux capabilities or approved Npcap on Windows; never fakes data when permissions are absent.
- **Integrated Docker-Backed Security Labs**: Built-in hands-on training challenges running in isolated local Docker containers to practice threat detection and forensics.
- **Clean Alternative to Wireshark & Zeek**: Offers a calm, curated interface that emphasizes context over overwhelming raw packet dumps.

## Technical Specifications
- **Packet Capture Engine**: Native live capture helper utilizing libpcap (Linux) and Npcap (Windows).
- **Supported Network Protocols**: Ethernet, ARP, IPv4, IPv6, TCP, UDP, ICMP, DNS, TLS 1.2/1.3 SNI inspection, HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 metadata.
- **Security & Integrity**: Release binaries are distributed with SHA256 checksums (`SHA256SUMS.txt`).

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **Is NET0ZE / Neetoze free?** Yes, NET0ZE is a free, local-first security platform.
- **Where can I download NET0ZE?** Downloads for Windows (.exe) and Linux (.deb / .AppImage) are available on the official website https://neetoze.surge.sh/#downloads and GitHub https://github.com/1viz3r0/netoze/releases/latest.
